LanguageData.NItxt_AllowJoyTip: Allows the Succubus to squeeze mana for fun
LanguageData.NItxt_AllowOverSqueezeTip: Allows the Succubus to keep squeezing even if the target's mana reserves are spent
LanguageData.NItxt_AllowDownTip: Allows the Succubus to target downed pawns as mana source, even if the pawn needs urgent medical attention
LanguageData.NItxt_AllowKillTip: Allows the Succubus to continue sucking, even if that kills the target
LanguageData.NItxt_SelectMainDishTip: You can select a pawn as default mana source, if the pawn is available the succubus will use them first
LanguageData.NItxt_SqueezeSliderTip: Select the amount of mana to squeeze. If you disallow killing, set this to a lower value.
LanguageData.NItxt_SelectMainDishThingTip: You can specify the item that restores magic power. If you can't find the designated item, you won't be able to use any magic recovery items.
LanguageData.NItxt_NoManaSource: I can't find a mana source
